title: French Coconut Cream Tart
description: A rich and creamy tart featuring a flaky pastry crust, topped with a coconut cream filling and baked to perfection.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough and place it in a tart pan.
Bake the pastry crust for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the coconut cream, Algerian cream, sugar, and vanilla extract.
In a small bowl, whisk together the egg yolks.
Temper the egg yolks by slowly pouring the coconut cream mixture into the egg yolks, whisking constantly.
Pour the coconut cream mixture into the baked pastry crust.
Bake the tart for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the filling is set.
Let the tart cool to room temperature before serving.
